about: Made-up subtopics in other languages, for question-only tests of generation in a language other than English: a Latin script with its own conventions (German), a script without spaces (Japanese) and a right-to-left one (Arabic). Topics and subtopics are written in the domain's language, as the pipeline writes them. Built by hand 2026-10-20; no company's text.

subtopics: 問い合わせの優先順位付け
